intro: Five two-sentence horror stories. Don't watch the last one alone.

lines: My daughter asked why the man in her closet never blinks.
I told her to go back to sleep. Then I remembered her room doesn't have a closet.
The realtor said the house came fully furnished.
She didn't mention the family photos on the wall change every night. Now I'm in them.
After the funeral, I kept calling my dad's phone just to hear his voicemail.
Last night, the message was different. It said: it's so dark in here.
I woke up to my phone's camera flash going off in the dark.
The newest photo in my gallery is me, asleep, taken from the ceiling.
Every night, my dog growls at the hallway mirror.
Tonight my reflection put a finger to its lips, and the dog went quiet.
